items: 【Twin Lake N150 & UHD Graphics】This Win 11 tablet pairs Intel’s quad-core N150 CPU (up to 3.6GHz Turbo) with UHD Graphics for seamless multitasking, HD video playback, and casual gaming-ideal for work and light entertainment on a power-efficient platform

【Win 11 Pro+ 12GB DDR5 + 512GB SSD + Advanced Cooling】Win11 Pro runs smoothly with 12GB DDR5 RAM, handling heavy apps and multilingual tasks. The 512GB NVMe SSD ensures fast boot-ups and file transfers. The large fan and dual-copper heat pipe effectively prevents throttling, maintaining stable performance

【11" FHD IPS In-Cell + Dual Cameras + 34.2Wh】A 11-inch FHD IPS In-Cell touchscreen (1920×1200) offers sharp visuals and responsive touch. Dual 5MP+8MP cameras cover video calls and quick snaps, while the 34.2Wh battery and Type-C fast charging ensure non-stop entertainment on the go

【Durable 635g Metal Body + Included Keyboard/Case (1106g)】Built with a rugged aluminum chassis (9.6mm thick, 635g), this lightweight tablet balances toughness and portability. The package includes a magnetic keyboard and protective case (total 1106g), enabling instant shifts between tablet creativity and laptop productivity for urgent tasks

【2×Type-C + Wi-Fi 6 + HDMI】Equipped with 2×Type-C (charging/data), USB 3.0, micro HDMI, and a 3.5mm jack, this tablet connects to monitors, peripherals, and networks effortlessly. Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5GHz) and Bluetooth 5.0 ensure lag-free streaming and stable device pairing
